# Starting processes

`posix_spawn` and its file actions, and waiting for and signalling a child.

<h2 id="spawn-file-actions"><code>SpawnFileActions</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct SpawnFileActions {
    // private fields
}
```

Room for a `posix_spawn_file_actions_t`, which each C library sizes its own way and none larger than this.
Only ever passed by address to the `posix_spawn_file_actions_*` calls, which initialize and read it.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L14)

**Constructors**

<h3 id="spawn-file-actions-new"><code>SpawnFileActions</code></h3>

```rux
pub func SpawnFileActions() -> SpawnFileActions
```

Zeroed storage for [`posix_spawn_file_actions_init`](/docs/api/freebsd/spawn#posix-spawn-file-actions-init) to initialize.

**Returns**: the storage

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L22)

<h2 id="f-setfd"><code>F_SETFD</code></h2>

```rux
pub const F_SETFD: int32 = 2;
```

`F_SETFD`: the [`fcntl`](/docs/api/freebsd/spawn#fcntl) command that sets a descriptor's flags.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L30)

<h2 id="fd-cloexec"><code>FD_CLOEXEC</code></h2>

```rux
pub const FD_CLOEXEC: int32 = 1;
```

`FD_CLOEXEC`: close the descriptor when the process starts another program.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L35)

<h2 id="wnohang"><code>WNOHANG</code></h2>

```rux
pub const WNOHANG: int32 = 1;
```

`WNOHANG`: have [`waitpid`](/docs/api/freebsd/spawn#waitpid) return at once when the child has not finished.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L40)

<h2 id="sigkill"><code>SIGKILL</code></h2>

```rux
pub const SIGKILL: int32 = 9;
```

`SIGKILL`: the signal that ends a process at once and cannot be caught.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L45)

<h2 id="posix-spawnp"><code>posix_spawnp</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func posix_spawnp(
    pid: *var int32,
    file: *char8,
    fileActions: *SpawnFileActions,
    attributes: *opaque,
    arguments: **char8,
    environment: **char8
) -> int32
```

Starts `file`, found through `PATH` when it has no slash, as a child process.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=posix_spawn&sektion=3](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=posix_spawn&sektion=3)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L59)

**Parameters**

| Name          | Type                | Description                                                            |
| ------------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pid`         | `*var int32`        | receives the child's process identifier                                |
| `file`        | `*char8`            | the program, NUL-terminated                                            |
| `fileActions` | `*SpawnFileActions` | the descriptor and directory setup to run in the child first, or null  |
| `attributes`  | `*opaque`           | spawn attributes, or null for the defaults                             |
| `arguments`   | `**char8`           | the argument vector, its first entry the program's name, ended by null |
| `environment` | `**char8`           | the environment, `NAME=VALUE` entries ended by null                    |

**Returns**: zero, or an error number

<h2 id="waitpid"><code>waitpid</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func waitpid(
    pid: int32,
    status: *var int32,
    options: int32
) -> int32
```

Waits for a child to change state, and reports how it finished.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=waitpid&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=waitpid&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L112)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type         | Description                                                                                                     |
| --------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pid`     | `int32`      | the child's process identifier                                                                                  |
| `status`  | `*var int32` | receives the encoded status                                                                                     |
| `options` | `int32`      | zero to wait, or [`WNOHANG`](/docs/api/freebsd/spawn#wnohang) to return at once when the child is still running |

**Returns**: the child's identifier, zero with [`WNOHANG`](/docs/api/freebsd/spawn#wnohang) when it is still running, or -1 with the reason in errno

<h2 id="fcntl"><code>fcntl</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func fcntl(
    fd: int32,
    command: int32,
    ...
) -> int32
```

Performs a control operation on a descriptor, such as setting its flags with [`F_SETFD`](/docs/api/freebsd/spawn#f-setfd).

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=fcntl&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=fcntl&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L128)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type    | Description    |
| --------- | ------- | -------------- |
| `fd`      | `int32` | the descriptor |
| `command` | `int32` | the operation  |
| `...`     |         |                |

**Returns**: the operation's result, or -1 with the reason in errno

<h2 id="errno"><code>__error</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func __error() -> *var int32
```

Returns the address of the calling thread's errno, where the C library calls above leave their reason.

**See also**: [https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=errno&sektion=2](https://man.freebsd.org/cgi/man.cgi?query=errno&sektion=2)

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FreeBSD/Src/Spawn.rux#L134)
